So do you guys feel you have a good understanding of what my risk and exposure is for what you guys are seeing or know about at this point? That we're all on the same starting point.

content.text:

So it would be an anti-plan to put forward and understand and create a plan that doesn't impact.

content.text:

content.text:

content.speaker: Speaker 4
